title: Toadpole
move_pattern: The move cycle depends on the IsFront property. If at front, the pattern is: Spiken → Spike Spit → Whirl (repeating). If not at front, the pattern is: Whirl → Spiken → Spike Spit (repeating). Thorns power affects animation states during combat.
notes: Toadpole uses Thorns as a core mechanic. Spiken applies 2 Thorns to itself, while Spike Spit removes 2 Thorns as a debuff effect. The presence of Thorns power modifies the monster's animation states, with separate animation sequences for buffed (with Thorns) and unbuffed states.
